2. "There are three points, though, which should be clarified in the final statement: it is unclear from Exhibit 6 which combination of attenuation measures were assumed in deriving the three noise-location curves; the locations of the three observation points should be indicated on Figure 8; and, there should be some diurnal (around the clock) distribution shown for periods of high noise." 
a. The external noise exposures in Exhibit No. 6 assume no attentuation measures and are merely intended as a graphic representation of noise at the three test locations as composed to HUD Interim Noise Exposure Standards, Circular 1390.2, Change 1, 9/1/71.
b. The location of the three observation points have been indicated on Figure 8.
c. The following letter, dated 27 April 1973, from Parker W. Hirtle of Bolt, Beranek and Newman includes the 24-hour traffic distribution assumed for the analysis.
